queries_run: Workday WDAY analyst consensus vs guidance 2026 fiscal year
WDAY price target analyst consensus September 2026
Workday WDAY Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings guidance raise cut analyst reaction August 2026
Workday WDAY stock price target cut lowered September 2026

findings.claim: Workday 2026-08-27公布FY2027第二季財報時上修FY2027訂閱營收指引至$9.940B–$9.950B(年增13%)，並將FY2027 non-GAAP營業利益率指引上修至31.0%；當季agentic AI產品新增ACV逾$100M，占當季全部新簽ACV逾25%。
findings.source: Workday newsroom press release 'Workday Announces Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Financial Results' (newsroom.workday.com), 2026-08-27

findings.claim: 財報公布當日(2026-08-27)股價收$193.57(+1.48%)，盤後波動輕微；報導解讀為市場視此次優於預期結果為『穩健執行』而非驚喜，反應偏中性。
findings.source: Investing.com, 'Workday Q2 FY27 slides: AI drives 25% of new sales, margins expand'

findings.claim: 財報後約一週內(2026年8月底至9月初)賣方目標價出現同時上修與下修：BTIG降評至中立(原買進)並撤回原$175目標價；Deutsche Bank降評至持有並下修目標價至$145(原$185)；Goldman Sachs上修目標價至$164(原$151)；Cantor Fitzgerald維持增持評等但下修目標價至$205(原$220)；Bernstein上修目標價至$238並維持優於大盤評等，理由為利益率展望轉正與FY2027指引更新。目標價區間$145–$238 vs numbers.price_at_dd，顯示賣方對本次財報後估值方向的分歧擴大。
findings.source: Investing.com/Yahoo Finance/Benzinga analyst-ratings coverage aggregated in 'These Analysts Revise Their Forecasts On Workday Following Q2 Results' (Benzinga) and 'Cantor Fitzgerald cuts Workday stock price target on guidance miss' (Investing.com)

findings.claim: 不同資料源對賣方目標價共識落差異常大：一來源引S&P Global統計41位分析師均值目標價$188.21、共識評等Buy；另一來源(51位分析師)則引中位數目標價達$280(區間$92–$326)。兩者中樞相差逾$90，反映Q2財報後賣方對合理估值的看法高度不一致，目標價區間本身 vs numbers.price_at_dd 需謹慎解讀。
findings.source: MarketScreener 'Workday Inc.: Target Price Consensus and Analysts Recommendations'; stockanalysis.com 'Workday (WDAY) Stock Forecast & Analyst Price Targets'

capital_markets_pricing.note: Q2 FY27法說(2026-08-27)後一週內賣方報告呈現罕見雙向分歧(降評/上修同時出現)，且不同彙總站對目標價共識的中樞估計本身落差逾$90，判斷層宜視為估值爭議未解決而非單向訊號。
